department: National Health Mission Tamil Nadu, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Health workers come to your home. They check you for high blood pressure and diabetes. If you are 45 or older and eligible, they bring your BP and sugar medicines to your door. A nurse and physiotherapist also give care at home to people who are very sick or bedridden, and help kidney patients on home dialysis (CAPD bags).

other: Home delivery of BP and sugar medicines is for eligible people aged 45 years and above.
